body: Fixed in 82f3f2dc4 (included in 7e06a76dc). Under the existing C1 bundle/reservation locks, admission releases only an exactly bound placed mapping whose order is durably CANCELLED; the legacy path uses the same authoritative predicate. The order pointer, audit and old COMMITTED receipt are retained, pending attempts remain fenced, and cancellation acquires no earlier claim locks. Tests-first CI116 was RED: https://github.com/humaux/live_commerce_architecture_v1/actions/runs/38484018646 . CI117 at 7e06a76dc is GREEN for TestOrderAttemptCancelReadmitFreshCAS (five native payment/catalogue branches including transfer expiry), TestOrderAttemptCancelReadmitLegacyBegin and TestOrderAttemptCancelReadmitConcurrentPrincipals: PASS=3 FAIL=0 SKIP=0, exit 0, job 115598078177: https://github.com/humaux/live_commerce_architecture_v1/actions/runs/38485486491/job/115598078177 . The tests retain the old cancelled order and receipt and prove at most one concurrent live replacement. This is targeted E3 evidence; whole-PR required Foundation remains blocked by the separately owned CI-DRIFT-FACTORY scanner issue.
